newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: POLL-UPDATED SURVEY OF NZ FPI, RETAIL TRADE DATA.
newsitem.headline: POLL-UPDATED SURVEY OF NZ FPI, RETAIL TRADE DATA.

text.p: The following is the result of a survey of economists for July Food Price Index data due on Wednesday August 13, and Retail Trade data for the month of June and the June quarter, due on Friday August 15.
Both sets of data will be released at 10.45 a.m. NZT, 2245 GMT (figures are percentage changes).
Please note retail trade forecasts from Bancorp and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell have been added, altering the averages etc from those previously published.

S/adj, mth on mth June -0.17 -4.6 +0.25 -2.5 to +1.2
S/adj, qtr on qtr June qtr +1.28 -1.0 +1.3 +0.4 to +1.8
from June 1996 qtr June qtr -0.03 -2.0 -0.35 -0.8 to +1.3

Respondents to the survey were: ASB Bank, Bancorp, Bankers Trust New Zealand, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Doyle Paterson Brown, Garlick and Co Ltd, Merrill Lynch New Zealand, National Bank of New Zealand, UBS Australia, WestpacTrust.
